Welcome to my Website! It's all done in R and GitHub, so that's pretty cool. Most of the data
updates itself on a schedule too.

![Sunset at China Walls on Oahu, Hawaii - Reminiscing of my life on Oahu](images/China Walls Sunset.jpg)

I thought it might be worth investing some time to make a website to point to an area of my life where it gets a little more professional. But then I thought, why *just* do that? Why not incorporate some other aspects of my life that makes me me. So yes, this will have my ever growing resume, but let's have a little bit of fun while we're here.

## Live Activity

```{r live-activity, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
read_json_safe <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path) || !requireNamespace("jsonlite", quietly = TRUE)) return(NULL)
  tryCatch(jsonlite::fromJSON(path, simplifyVector = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
}

lately <- read_json_safe("data/lately.json")
changelog <- read_json_safe("data/changelog.json")

commits <- if (!is.null(lately$commits)) lately$commits else "—"
areas <- if (!is.null(lately$active_areas)) length(lately$active_areas) else "—"
events <- if (!is.null(changelog$events)) length(changelog$events) else "—"
updated <- if (!is.null(lately$generated_at)) substr(lately$generated_at, 1, 10) else "waiting for first refresh"

panel <- paste0(
  '<div class="live-activity-panel">',
  '<div class="live-activity-topline"><span class="live-dot"></span> LIVE DATA <span class="live-updated">Updated ', updated, '</span></div>',
  '<div class="live-stat-grid">',
  '<div class="live-stat"><strong>', commits, '</strong><span>commits · 30 days</span></div>',
  '<div class="live-stat"><strong>', areas, '</strong><span>active areas</span></div>',
  '<div class="live-stat"><strong>', events, '</strong><span>recent events</span></div>',
  '</div>',
  '<div class="live-art-wrap"><img src="assets/generated/activity.svg" alt="Thirty days of automatically generated repository activity" class="live-activity-art" onerror="this.parentElement.style.display=\'none\'"></div>',
  '<p class="live-explainer">This section is generated from the same GitHub Actions that build and refresh the site. The numbers and activity visualization update automatically.</p>',
  '</div>'
)
cat(panel)

if (!is.null(changelog$daily_summaries) && length(changelog$daily_summaries) > 0) {
  recent_days <- head(changelog$daily_summaries, 5)
  day_html <- vapply(recent_days, function(day) {
    date_label <- if (!is.null(day$date)) {
      d <- as.Date(day$date)
      toupper(format(d, "%b %d"))
    } else {
      ""
    }
    item_html <- vapply(day$items, function(item) {
      emoji <- if (!is.null(item$emoji)) item$emoji else "✨"
      text <- if (!is.null(item$text)) item$text else "Site updated"
      body <- paste0('<span class="activity-emoji">', emoji, '</span><span>', text, '</span>')
      if (!is.null(item$url) && nzchar(item$url)) {
        body <- paste0('<a href="', item$url, '">', body, '</a>')
      }
      paste0('<li>', body, '</li>')
    }, character(1))
    paste0(
      '<div class="activity-day">',
      '<div class="activity-date">', date_label, '</div>',
      '<ul>', paste(item_html, collapse = ""), '</ul>',
      '</div>'
    )
  }, character(1))
  cat(paste0(
    '<div class="recent-activity">',
    '<div class="recent-activity-heading"><h3>What I’ve been up to</h3>',
    '<span>Big-picture highlights from recent commits + merged PRs</span></div>',
    paste(day_html, collapse = ""),
    '</div>'
  ))
}
```

## Developer Year in Review

Commit totals and streaks reflect my personal commits in public repositories. Automated bot commits are excluded. Streaks use UTC calendar days.

```{r home-year-review, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
files <- list.files("data/year-in-review", pattern = "^[0-9]{4}\\.json$", full.names = TRUE)
if (!length(files) || !requireNamespace("jsonlite", quietly = TRUE)) {
  cat('<div class="year-hero"><div class="year-kicker">Developer archive</div><div class="year-title">YEAR IN CODE</div><p>The first snapshot will appear here after the GitHub Action runs.</p></div>')
} else {
  years <- as.integer(sub("\\.json$", "", basename(files)))
  d <- jsonlite::fromJSON(files[which.max(years)])
  val <- function(x, fallback="—") if (is.null(x) || is.na(x) || identical(x, "")) fallback else x
  fmt <- function(x) if (is.numeric(x)) format(x, big.mark=",", scientific=FALSE, trim=TRUE) else val(x)
  cat(paste0(
    '<style>.year-hero{margin:1.5rem 0 2rem;padding:2.2rem;border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#111827,#1f2937);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}.year-kicker{text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.16em;font-size:.8rem;opacity:.72}.year-title{font-size:clamp(2.3rem,7vw,5.6rem);line-height:.95;margin:.4rem 0 1.6rem;font-weight:800}.year-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(145px,1fr));gap:1rem}.year-stat{padding:1rem;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}.year-stat strong{display:block;font-size:1.8rem}.year-stat span{opacity:.72;font-size:.9rem}.year-details{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:.8rem;margin-top:1.2rem}.year-detail{padding:.9rem 1rem;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}.year-project{margin-top:1.2rem;padding:1rem 1.1rem;border-left:4px solid #60a5fa;background:rgba(96,165,250,.12);border-radius:0 10px 10px 0}.year-link{display:inline-block;margin-top:1rem;color:#bfdbfe!important;font-weight:600}</style>',
    '<div class="year-hero"><div class="year-kicker">Developer year in review</div>',
    '<div class="year-title">', d$year, ' IN CODE</div>',
    '<div class="year-grid">',
    '<div class="year-stat"><strong>', fmt(d$commits), '</strong><span>commits</span></div>',
    '<div class="year-stat"><strong>', fmt(d$pull_requests), '</strong><span>pull requests</span></div>',
    '<div class="year-stat"><strong>', fmt(d$repositories_touched), '</strong><span>repositories touched</span></div>',
    '<div class="year-stat"><strong>', fmt(d$lines_added), '</strong><span>lines added</span></div></div>',
    '<div class="year-details">',
    '<div class="year-detail"><strong>Top language by lines added:</strong> ', val(d$most_used_language), '</div>',
    '<div class="year-detail"><strong>Most-active month:</strong> ', val(d$most_active_month), '</div>',
    '<div class="year-detail"><strong>Longest streak:</strong> ', fmt(d$longest_streak_days), ' days</div></div>',
    '<div class="year-project"><strong>Biggest project</strong><br>', val(d$biggest_project),
    if (!is.null(d$biggest_project_commits)) paste0(' · ', fmt(d$biggest_project_commits), ' commits') else '', '</div>',
    '<a class="year-link" href="year_in_review.html">View the year-by-year archive →</a></div>'
  ))
}
```
